verdict.rationale: While Postman documents collections, mock servers, and CLI tooling, none of the evidence describes an interactive, browsable API reference page with runnable code examples (e.g. Postman's public API documentation/'Run in Postman' feature) — the pack only covers scripting, CLI usage, mock servers, and collaboration workspaces. missing for 10: explicit documentation of published/interactive API reference pages, runnable code snippets in docs, or a 'Run in Postman' style embed feature.
